latest.title: Shape Optimization and Bernoulli Free Boundary Problems for the Riemannian $p$-Laplacian
latest.abstract: We study an exterior Bernoulli-type free boundary problem associated with the Riemannian $p$-Laplacian on a compact Riemannian manifold. Following the shape-optimization strategy of Ly and Seck, we formulate the corresponding volume-constrained shape optimization problem, derive its first shape derivative, obtain the overdetermined Bernoulli condition through a Lagrange multiplier, and establish a conditional monotonicity result under a Riemannian contraction hypothesis. The final successive-approximation argument will require additional geometric and boundary-flux stability assumptions.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 把黎曼 p-Laplacian 的外 Bernoulli 自由边界问题写成带体积约束的形状优化，并导出一阶变分和过定边界条件。
latest.breakthrough: 在黎曼背景下建立变分框架并得到条件性单调结论。
latest.limitations: 最终逐次逼近仍需额外几何和边界通量稳定性假设，完整存在性尚未闭合。
